summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests whether canakinumab can prevent progression to cancer in people with clonal cytopenia of undetermined significance (CCUS), a blood condition with long-term low blood counts. Canakinumab is given as a subcutaneous injection, compared with a placebo injection given the same way; how often and for how long are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa si canakinumab puede prevenir la progresión a cáncer en personas con citopenia clonal de significado indeterminado (CCUS), una condición de la sangre con conteos sanguíneos bajos por un período prolongado. Canakinumab se administra como inyección subcutánea, en comparación con una inyección de placebo aplicada de la misma forma; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es un ensayo de fase 2 aleatorizado, doble ciego y controlado con placebo.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with high-risk CCUS
Unexplained low blood counts in at least one blood cell type, lasting more than 4 months
Specified gene mutations found on sequencing and bone marrow tests
Able to understand and sign the written consent form
not_for: Current cancer in need of active systemic treatment
Diagnosis of MDS or another myeloid malignancy at any time
Known allergy or hypersensitivity to canakinumab or similar drugs
Active infection or history of recurrent infections
Active liver disease, hepatitis B or C, or positive HIV test
